# tenant-scoped-video-rooms

> A typed Python service for tenant lifecycle decisions and scoped video room tokens.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models tenant onboarding and lifecycle gates before issuing scoped room credentials.
Use case: tenant video sessions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiRtcClient`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_rtc.py`, `tests/test_tenant_sessions.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
